questions.q: Name 3 minerals from which energy is obtained
questions.a: Crude oil, natural gas and coal

questions.q: What is mining?
questions.a: Taking material/raw materials out of the ground, which are then processed further into products

Define corrosion
questions.a: Base metals react with oxygen from the air in a moist environment, and this is called corrosion

questions.q: What is corrosion of iron called?
What must be different between two liquids to be able to separate them by distillation?
questions.a: They must have different boiling points

What is cracking?
questions.a: Breaking larger hydrocarbon molecules into smaller pieces. This is often done with the heavier hydrocarbon fractions obtained during the distillation of crude oil

questions.q: What can be obtained from cracked fractions?
questions.a: e.g. petrol for cars and substances that can be used in the chemical industry to make, for example, plastics or medicines

questions.q: Name three properties of metals
questions.a: They conduct electricity, they shine when polished, they conduct heat, and they can change shape without breaking (unlike salt crystals, for example)

questions.q: Which atoms are metals often bonded to in metal ores?
What is the property of noble metals?
questions.a: Noble metals show little or no corrosion, so they react poorly with oxygen in the air

questions.q: Name 2 noble metals
24 carat gold is 100% gold. 12 carat is a mix of 50% gold with other metals. How many carats is 75% gold?
What do you call a metal that is a mix of several metals? And why are these used?
questions.a: An alloy. These are used because they have better properties, for example they corrode less, are harder, or are easier to work

questions.q: Zinc is a base metal, yet it can be used for roof gutters. Explain why.
questions.a: When zinc reacts with oxygen from the air, zinc oxide (ZnO (s)) forms. This forms an impermeable layer, so corrosion stops and the zinc below this layer stays in good condition.

What are fossil fuels?
questions.a: Fossil fuels were formed from the remains of plants and animals that died millions of years ago

questions.q: Which two fossil fuels do we extract from the ground in the Netherlands?
questions.a: Crude oil in Drenthe and natural gas in Groningen

questions.q: Plastics are molecular substances. Do they conduct electric current well or badly?
Name 4 products that plastics are used for
questions.a: Drinking bottles, plastic bags, packaging, coffee cups, chip trays, clothing, artificial grass, bulletproof vests, toys

questions.q: What are the advantages of plastics?
questions.a: Light, strong, resistant to many kinds of chemical compounds, waterproof, cheap and easy to make, can be recycled well

questions.q: What are the disadvantages of plastics?
questions.a: Burning releases greenhouse gases, and plastics often contain additives that get into the environment when they are burnt; many plastics are difficult to break down biologically

Why do we protect ourselves against radiation?
questions.a: Because radiation can damage biological tissue and thereby increases the chance of getting cancer

questions.q: Name 3 measures by which we protect ourselves against radiation
questions.a: Keeping a distance from the radiation source, putting a shield between the radiation source and yourself, being exposed to radiation for as short a time as possible, wearing protective clothing
